```{=html}
<style>
.two-flavor-lab {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 300px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
  align-items: stretch;
  width: min(1160px, 100%);
  margin: 0.25rem auto 0;
  color: #f3f5f7;
  font-size: 19px;
}

.two-flavor-lab__controls,
.two-flavor-lab__plot {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(7, 11, 17, 0.92);
}

.two-flavor-lab__controls {
  padding: 16px 18px;
}

.two-flavor-lab__plot {
  position: relative;
  padding: 8px 12px 4px;
}

.two-flavor-lab__axis-title {
  position: absolute;
  right: 38px;
  bottom: 7px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1;
}

.two-flavor-lab__control + .two-flavor-lab__control {
  margin-top: 17px;
}

.two-flavor-lab__control label {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  color: #dbe2ea;
}

.two-flavor-lab__control output {
  color: #7cc7ff;
  font-weight: 750;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.two-flavor-lab input[type="range"] {
  width: 100%;
  accent-color: #58b8ff;
}

.two-flavor-lab__derived {
  margin-top: 15px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(124, 199, 255, 0.09);
  color: #dbe2ea;
  text-align: center;
}

.two-flavor-lab__derived strong {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.two-flavor-lab__probabilities {
  margin-top: 16px;
}

.two-flavor-lab__probability + .two-flavor-lab__probability {
  margin-top: 11px;
}

.two-flavor-lab__probability-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  font-size: 0.84em;
}

.two-flavor-lab__probability-head strong {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.two-flavor-lab__track {
  height: 13px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

.two-flavor-lab__fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: inherit;
  transition: width 80ms linear;
}

.two-flavor-lab__fill--appearance {
  background: #58b8ff;
}

.two-flavor-lab__fill--survival {
  background: #ffc85c;
}

.two-flavor-lab__hint {
  margin-top: 15px;
  color: #aeb9c7;
  font-size: 0.76em;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.two-flavor-lab__svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 410px;
}

.two-flavor-lab__axis,
.two-flavor-lab__tick {
  stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}

.two-flavor-lab__grid {
  stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.two-flavor-lab__curve {
  fill: none;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  stroke-width: 4.5;
}

.two-flavor-lab__curve--appearance {
  stroke: #58b8ff;
}

.two-flavor-lab__curve--survival {
  stroke: #ffc85c;
}

.two-flavor-lab__cursor {
  stroke: #7ee2ae;
  stroke-width: 2;
  stroke-dasharray: 7 7;
}

.two-flavor-lab__point {
  stroke: #07111a;
  stroke-width: 2.5;
}

.two-flavor-lab__point--appearance {
  fill: #58b8ff;
}

.two-flavor-lab__point--survival {
  fill: #ffc85c;
}

.two-flavor-lab__text {
  fill: #cfd7e2;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: 17px;
}

.two-flavor-lab__text--axis {
  fill: #ffffff;
  font-size: 21px;
  font-style: italic;
}

.two-flavor-lab__text--appearance {
  fill: #58b8ff;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.two-flavor-lab__text--survival {
  fill: #ffc85c;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .two-flavor-lab {
    grid-template-columns: 270px minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  .two-flavor-lab__controls {
    padding: 12px;
  }

  .two-flavor-lab__svg {
    height: 365px;
  }
}
</style>

<div class="two-flavor-lab" data-two-flavor-lab>
  <div class="two-flavor-lab__controls">
    <div class="two-flavor-lab__control">
      <label>
        <span>Угол смешивания <i>θ</i></span>
        <output data-theta-output>30.0°</output>
      </label>
      <input data-theta-input type="range" min="0" max="45" step="0.5" value="30"
             aria-label="Угол смешивания в градусах">
    </div>

    <div class="two-flavor-lab__derived">
      Амплитуда<br>
      <strong><i>A</i> = sin²2<i>θ</i> = <span data-amplitude-output>0.750</span></strong>
    </div>

    <div class="two-flavor-lab__control">
      <label>
        <span>Пройденный путь</span>
        <output data-distance-output>0.25 <i>L</i><sub>osc</sub></output>
      </label>
      <input data-distance-input type="range" min="0" max="2" step="0.01" value="0.25"
             aria-label="Расстояние в единицах длины осцилляций">
    </div>

    <div class="two-flavor-lab__probabilities">
      <div class="two-flavor-lab__probability">
        <div class="two-flavor-lab__probability-head">
          <span><i>P</i><sub>α→β</sub></span>
          <strong data-appearance-output>0.375</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="two-flavor-lab__track">
          <div class="two-flavor-lab__fill two-flavor-lab__fill--appearance"
               data-appearance-fill style="width: 37.5%"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="two-flavor-lab__probability">
        <div class="two-flavor-lab__probability-head">
          <span><i>P</i><sub>α→α</sub></span>
          <strong data-survival-output>0.625</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="two-flavor-lab__track">
          <div class="two-flavor-lab__fill two-flavor-lab__fill--survival"
               data-survival-fill style="width: 62.5%"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="two-flavor-lab__hint">
      Здесь <i>x</i> = <i>L</i>/<i>L</i><sub>osc</sub>, поэтому
      <i>P</i><sub>α→β</sub> = <i>A</i> sin²(π<i>x</i>).
      Угол задаёт высоту, путь — положение на осцилляции.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="two-flavor-lab__plot">
    <svg class="two-flavor-lab__svg" viewBox="0 0 800 410"
         role="img" aria-label="Интерактивные вероятности появления и выживания">
      <line class="two-flavor-lab__grid" x1="62" y1="70" x2="752" y2="70"></line>
      <line class="two-flavor-lab__grid" x1="62" y1="205" x2="752" y2="205"></line>
      <line class="two-flavor-lab__axis" x1="62" y1="340" x2="752" y2="340"></line>
      <line class="two-flavor-lab__axis" x1="62" y1="340" x2="62" y2="58"></line>

      <g aria-hidden="true">
        <line class="two-flavor-lab__tick" x1="62" y1="340" x2="62" y2="349"></line>
        <line class="two-flavor-lab__tick" x1="234.5" y1="340" x2="234.5" y2="349"></line>
        <line class="two-flavor-lab__tick" x1="407" y1="340" x2="407" y2="349"></line>
        <line class="two-flavor-lab__tick" x1="579.5" y1="340" x2="579.5" y2="349"></line>
        <line class="two-flavor-lab__tick" x1="752" y1="340" x2="752" y2="349"></line>
        <text class="two-flavor-lab__text" x="62" y="374" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
        <text class="two-flavor-lab__text" x="234.5" y="374" text-anchor="middle">1/2</text>
        <text class="two-flavor-lab__text" x="407" y="374" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
        <text class="two-flavor-lab__text" x="579.5" y="374" text-anchor="middle">3/2</text>
        <text class="two-flavor-lab__text" x="752" y="374" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
        <text class="two-flavor-lab__text" x="44" y="346" text-anchor="end">0</text>
        <text class="two-flavor-lab__text" x="44" y="211" text-anchor="end">1/2</text>
        <text class="two-flavor-lab__text" x="44" y="76" text-anchor="end">1</text>
        <text class="two-flavor-lab__text two-flavor-lab__text--axis" x="24" y="48">P</text>
      </g>

      <path class="two-flavor-lab__curve two-flavor-lab__curve--appearance"
            data-appearance-path></path>
      <path class="two-flavor-lab__curve two-flavor-lab__curve--survival"
            data-survival-path></path>
      <line class="two-flavor-lab__cursor" data-cursor y1="58" y2="340"></line>
      <circle class="two-flavor-lab__point two-flavor-lab__point--appearance"
              data-appearance-point r="7"></circle>
      <circle class="two-flavor-lab__point two-flavor-lab__point--survival"
              data-survival-point r="7"></circle>
      <text class="two-flavor-lab__text two-flavor-lab__text--appearance"
            data-appearance-label x="265" y="124">P<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="14">α→β</tspan></text>
      <text class="two-flavor-lab__text two-flavor-lab__text--survival"
            data-survival-label x="265" y="302">P<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="14">α→α</tspan></text>
    </svg>
    <div class="two-flavor-lab__axis-title"><i>L</i> / <i>L</i><sub>osc</sub></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const X0 = 62;
  const X1 = 752;
  const Y0 = 340;
  const Y1 = 70;

  const plotX = x => X0 + (X1 - X0) * x / 2;
  const plotY = probability => Y0 - (Y0 - Y1) * probability;

  function probability(amplitude, x) {
    return amplitude * Math.sin(Math.PI * x) ** 2;
  }

  function makePath(amplitude, survival) {
    const points = [];
    for (let index = 0; index <= 240; index += 1) {
      const x = 2 * index / 240;
      const appearance = probability(amplitude, x);
      const value = survival ? 1 - appearance : appearance;
      points.push(`${index === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${plotX(x).toFixed(2)},${plotY(value).toFixed(2)}`);
    }
    return points.join(" ");
  }

  function initialize(root) {
    if (root.dataset.twoFlavorReady === "true") return;
    root.dataset.twoFlavorReady = "true";

    const thetaInput = root.querySelector("[data-theta-input]");
    const distanceInput = root.querySelector("[data-distance-input]");
    const thetaOutput = root.querySelector("[data-theta-output]");
    const distanceOutput = root.querySelector("[data-distance-output]");
    const amplitudeOutput = root.querySelector("[data-amplitude-output]");
    const appearanceOutput = root.querySelector("[data-appearance-output]");
    const survivalOutput = root.querySelector("[data-survival-output]");
    const appearanceFill = root.querySelector("[data-appearance-fill]");
    const survivalFill = root.querySelector("[data-survival-fill]");
    const appearancePath = root.querySelector("[data-appearance-path]");
    const survivalPath = root.querySelector("[data-survival-path]");
    const cursor = root.querySelector("[data-cursor]");
    const appearancePoint = root.querySelector("[data-appearance-point]");
    const survivalPoint = root.querySelector("[data-survival-point]");
    const appearanceLabel = root.querySelector("[data-appearance-label]");
    const survivalLabel = root.querySelector("[data-survival-label]");

    function draw() {
      const thetaDegrees = Number(thetaInput.value);
      const theta = thetaDegrees * Math.PI / 180;
      const x = Number(distanceInput.value);
      const amplitude = Math.sin(2 * theta) ** 2;
      const appearance = probability(amplitude, x);
      const survival = 1 - appearance;
      const cursorX = plotX(x);

      thetaOutput.textContent = `${thetaDegrees.toFixed(1)}°`;
      distanceOutput.innerHTML = `${x.toFixed(2)} <i>L</i><sub>osc</sub>`;
      amplitudeOutput.textContent = amplitude.toFixed(3);
      appearanceOutput.textContent = appearance.toFixed(3);
      survivalOutput.textContent = survival.toFixed(3);
      appearanceFill.style.width = `${(100 * appearance).toFixed(1)}%`;
      survivalFill.style.width = `${(100 * survival).toFixed(1)}%`;

      appearancePath.setAttribute("d", makePath(amplitude, false));
      survivalPath.setAttribute("d", makePath(amplitude, true));
      cursor.setAttribute("x1", cursorX.toFixed(2));
      cursor.setAttribute("x2", cursorX.toFixed(2));
      appearancePoint.setAttribute("cx", cursorX.toFixed(2));
      appearancePoint.setAttribute("cy", plotY(appearance).toFixed(2));
      survivalPoint.setAttribute("cx", cursorX.toFixed(2));
      survivalPoint.setAttribute("cy", plotY(survival).toFixed(2));
      appearanceLabel.setAttribute("y", Math.max(82, plotY(amplitude) - 14).toFixed(2));
      survivalLabel.setAttribute("y", Math.min(326, plotY(1 - amplitude) + 52).toFixed(2));
    }

    thetaInput.addEventListener("input", draw);
    distanceInput.addEventListener("input", draw);
    draw();
  }

  function initializeAll() {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-two-flavor-lab]").forEach(initialize);
  }

  initializeAll();
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeAll, {once: true});
})();
</script>
```
